name: Yuletide Regicide
source:
Santa Claus, the King of Christmas, has been murdered. Brutally butchered in his Throne Room on the North Pole. Our dynamic duo of deduction and delinquency, investigative journalist Deliria B. Murder and the undead detective Skullbert "Skully" McSkullface, arrives to the scene in a timely manner, ready to get to the bottom of this scandalous scoop and most-likely-illegal impalement.

Suspects abound from dissatisfied elves to flying reindeer, not to forget the possible marriage trouble with Mrs. Claus. Luckily, the CIA is already digging through the crime scene, so you can be sure the investigation is in good hands... Right?

translation:
圣诞节之王圣诞老人被谋杀了。在他位于北极的王座室中遭到残酷屠杀。我们充满活力的推理和犯罪二人组，调查记者德利里亚·B·谋杀案和不死侦探骷髅伯特·“骷髅”·麦克骷髅脸及时到达现场，准备查明这起丑闻和最有可能是非法刺刑的真相。

从心怀不满的精灵到会飞的驯鹿，嫌疑人比比皆是，更不要忘记与克劳斯夫人可能出现的婚姻问题。幸运的是，中央情报局已经开始对犯罪现场进行挖掘，所以你可以确定调查工作进展顺利……对吗？
